title: End-of-content synoptic assessment
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Apply the full course
blocks.text: The questions deliberately combine techniques from different H446 content areas.

blocks.title: Allocate time
blocks.text: Plan roughly fifteen minutes for each fifteen-mark section; show every intermediate result.

blocks.title: Mark and diagnose
blocks.text: Review after students finish, awarding only explicit method and accuracy evidence.
